name: Niagara Bottling - Elko New Market MN

fieldNotes._location: Roster coordinates (46.732498, -92.201007) were badly wrong — they pointed to a forested highway interchange near Duluth, ~250 km north of Elko New Market. Corrected via web research: the plant is the 425,000 sq ft, $125M Niagara facility in the SE quadrant of the I-35 / Scott County Road 2 interchange in Elko New Market's Park I-35 Industrial Park. Building shell positively identified in satellite imagery at ~44.5676, -93.2900.
fieldNotes._constructionState: Facility is UNDER CONSTRUCTION in all available imagery (Phase 1 targeted operational 2025). The building shell/roof is complete, but the truck yard — dock face, aprons, trailer parking, perimeter road, and any gate/guard booth — is still graded dirt and not yet built or captured. Operational classification fields cannot be observed; all are listed in uncertainFields and the classification values are placeholder defaults, not observed evidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors not yet constructed/visible — set NONE as a placeholder, not an observation.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard not yet constructed/visible — set NONE as a placeholder.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Entrance infrastructure not yet built/imaged; classified false only as a placeholder default.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is in a new industrial park on the edge of Elko New Market (~35 mi south of Minneapolis), surrounded by farm fields and woods — Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible; the BNSF/UP corridor in the area does not appear to enter this parcel, but cannot be confirmed at this construction stage.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~36 acres estimated from the graded property boundary in satellite imagery; approximate, the final fenced perimeter may differ.
fieldNotes._recommendation: Flag for re-audit once post-completion satellite/Street View imagery (expected 2026+) becomes available; the yard layout, gate, and dock counts cannot be determined from current construction-stage imagery.
